results.title: Watch: Can India crack New Zealand’s pace challenge in Wellington Test?
results.content: From windy Wellington, The Hindu’s Amol Karhadkar previews India’s crucial Test series opener against New Zealand. With the four-pacer combination still under wraps, India will look to counter New Zealand’s pace threat and keep their World Test Championship final hopes alive. Amol also looks at Shubman Gill’s leadership, India’s batting challenge and Rishabh Pant’s opportunity to make a strong statement.
